description: The form Windows gives the short name of a longer one: at most 8 characters before a single dot, the last of them a tilde and digits after at least one other, and at most 3 after the dot, every one of them an ASCII letter of either case, a digit or one of ! # $ % & ' ( ) - @ ^ _ ` { } ~. On NTFS such a name may be the short name of another entry, which every driver answers for and none lists.

cases.name: filmna~1.mkv
cases.note: ntfs3 answers a short name whatever its case

cases.name: F-_(@)~9.A{B
cases.note: the punctuation a short name may hold, 8 and 3 characters

cases.name: FILM~1A.MKV
cases.note: the digits end the part before the dot

cases.name: FILMNA~1.
cases.note: a dot with nothing after it

cases.name: FILM+A~1.MKV
cases.note: + is no character of a short name

cases.name: S01E01.mkv
cases.note: an 8.3 name of its own: NTFS compares it without case, as any other
